records.title: Apple Pencil Pro (reference outside Android)
records.summary: Haptic pencil whose feedback apps request semantically through UICanvasFeedbackGenerator on compatible iPads.
details: The system decides whether a haptic plays, based on device, app state and battery.
A developer forum report says the pencil buzzes only for feedback tied to a pencil touch, not a finger touch. Not confirmed by Apple.
records.basis: Apple documentation via search results, 2 Nov 2026.

records.title: Huawei M-Pencil Pro
records.summary: Huawei's haptic pen, with feedback mostly tied to system gestures.
details: 10,000+ pressure levels, up to 16,384 on supported configurations.
Internal haptic motor, squeeze and double-tap gestures.
NearLink connectivity on compatible hardware. NearLink is a radio link, not a haptics API.
App and tablet compatibility varies.
records.basis: Huawei product pages via the research inventory.

records.title: Lenovo Tab Pen Pro (AP600U)
records.summary: Lenovo's haptic pen, which uses the LPP pen protocol and pairs over Bluetooth LE.
details: 8,192 pressure levels, tilt detection, six-degree-of-freedom sensing.
LPP 3.0/2.0 pen protocol, Bluetooth LE pairing, integrated haptics.
80 mAh battery, Qi wireless charging.
Having Bluetooth LE and LPP does not show that the motor is controlled through a publicly accessible Bluetooth characteristic.
records.basis: Lenovo specification pages via the research inventory.

records.title: OnePlus Pad Pro (caihong) / Pad 2 (rainbow)
records.summary: The 2024 OnePlus tablets the original stylus firmware fix was written for.
details: Codename caihong: OnePlus Pad Pro (China). Codename rainbow: OnePlus Pad 2 (global).
Kernel 6.1.68-android14, from the oplus_wireless_pen.ko module info.
Pen firmware directories 23926, 23927, 23976 and 23978 under /odm/firmware/wireless_pen/.
records.basis: cxzlw README and crDroid device tree.

records.title: OnePlus Pad 3
records.summary: The only tablet the repository has been tested on.
details: Global OxygenOS, converted from OPD2413 (ColorOS) to OPD2415, Android 16.
Other OnePlus and Oppo devices with the same accessory service may work but are untested.
A converted tablet also needs stylus charger firmware in /odm/firmware/wireless_pen/<prjname>/ before the pen will pair. See the pen attach handshake record.

It appears to be the same hardware family as the OnePlus Pad 2 Pro (China), whose project numbers are 24926 and 24976. The converted Pad 3 probably reports one of them; confirm with adb shell getprop ro.boot.prjname. Inferred.

records.title: OnePlus Stylo 2
records.summary: OnePlus's haptic stylus for the Pad 3. Normal pen input already works; haptics are reachable only through OnePlus's system service.
details: Advertised: 16,000 pressure levels.
Internal linear haptic motor with feedback that changes with the selected tool.
Verified in the README: the accessory service com.oplus.ipemanager/.btadsorb.CoreService talks to the pen over Bluetooth.
records.basis: Vendor specifications from the research inventory, plus the repository README.

records.title: Windows 11 haptic pen (device class)
records.summary: Any pen built to Microsoft's haptic pen guide. It works with Windows' inbox drivers, with no vendor service in between.
details: Connects with HID over Bluetooth using inbox drivers.
Must also meet the general Windows pen implementation guide.

records.title: Xiaomi Focus Pen Pro
records.summary: Xiaomi's haptic stylus with squeeze and slide gestures, backed by the most complete public vendor SDK.
details: Advertised: 16,384 pressure levels, integrated haptic motor, squeeze, double-press and slide gestures. Works with supported Xiaomi tablets (Pad 7, Pad 8).
Verified: it has a separate posture sensor, read through libssc in xiaomi-sheng-thp.
Verified: FocusPenProX was tested with it on a Pad 8 Pro (25091RP04C).
records.basis: Vendor specifications plus the two project READMEs.
